class.name: DisEntityTypeMapping
class.brief_description: One entity type pattern and the scene it selects, used by [DisEntityTypeMap].
class.description: Pairs a pattern for the 7 entity type fields (kind:domain:country:category:subcategory:specific:extra) with a scene. Each field is a non-negative integer or [code]*[/code], which matches anything. Trailing fields can be left out and then count as [code]*[/code]: [code]1:2[/code] matches every air platform, [code]1:2:*:1[/code] air platforms of category 1 of any country. An entity type shorter than 7 fields is treated as if the missing fields were 0. A mapping with an invalid or empty pattern never matches; setting an invalid pattern prints a warning.

method.name: get_specificity
method.description: Returns the number of fields of the pattern that are not wildcards (0 to 7), or [code]-1[/code] if the pattern is invalid. [DisEntityTypeMap] prefers the mapping with the highest value.

method.name: matches
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param entity_type] (7 integers; missing trailing fields count as 0) matches the pattern in every non-wildcard field. Always [code]false[/code] if the pattern is invalid.

members.member: The pattern as text, for example [code]"1:1:225:1:1"[/code]. See the class description for the syntax.
The scene instanced for matching entities.
